mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2.5% does not correlate with tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points over the previous month signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decrease > 0.2pp does not correlate with increased consumer confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the previous two months signals increased demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous two months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decrease > 1% does not correlate with negative market sentiment.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points, it signals a strong consumer-driven economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with a strong consumer-driven economy.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with tightening monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the previous three months signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points over the previous month, it signals a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increase > 2% QoQ and UNRATE decrease > 0.2pp
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with robust economic expansion.
